title: Google says users with a standard account can now build personal Android apps for free in AI Studio and will be able to share them with friends in coming months (Artie Beaty/ZDNET)
summary: Artie Beaty / ZDNET: Google says users with a standard account can now build personal Android apps for free in AI Studio and will be able to share them with friends in coming months — It just got a whole lot easier to vibe code the exact Android app you need - no developer experience required. — ZDNET's key takeaways
